requirements.REQ-01: Accepted events use one stable event/message identity across publish retries.
requirements.REQ-02: The edge journal records publish success only after a positive durable publish acknowledgement.
requirements.REQ-03: Origin generation is explicit; recreation and sequence regression are held for operator approval.
requirements.REQ-04: The hub raw archive is source-only with unique physical origin stream names and non-overlapping derived subjects.
requirements.REQ-07: A redelivered event cannot create the same downstream business effect twice.
requirements.REQ-08: A committed effect is reused across ACK-boundary redelivery without inserting a second effect.
requirements.REQ-09: Poison events are quarantined without completing the business effect or advancing application progress.
requirements.REQ-10: Restart/health progress validates JetStream acknowledgement floors against the durable effect ledger.
requirements.REQ-11: Reconciliation compares stable event identity rather than counts or hub aggregate sequence.
requirements.REQ-13: Convergence waits until required-consumer application checkpoints reach the confirmed watermark.
requirements.REQ-14: Replay planning selects only missing identities for a confirmed generation.
requirements.REQ-15: A later publish retry still uses the same stable message identity after the first attempt fails.
requirements.REQ-16: Cleanup-safe sequence is the minimum of archive floor, slowest required consumer, and active replay pin minus one.
requirements.REQ-19: Configured raw-stream max-age covers disconnect plus replay plus safety.
requirements.REQ-20: Recovery leases increment fence_epoch on expired reacquire and reject stale epochs.
requirements.REQ-21: Overlapping active replay ranges are rejected.
requirements.REQ-23: Cleanup excludes held rows and rows newer than the minimum journal age.
requirements.REQ-24: verify writes truthful health.json and reconciliation.json without erasing incident gaps.
requirements.REQ-25: inspect and reconcile do not apply replay or retention mutations.
requirements.REQ-26: Existing continuityctl generation, replay, lease and retention entrypoints remain operational.
